veranderings.rede: Keeps the 'nie net met ... maar ook met ...' pair parallel.

veranderings.voor: Ons noem sulke prente op rotse rotskuns.
veranderings.na: Sulke prente op rotse noem ons rotskuns.
veranderings.rede: Avoids the awkward 'rotse rotskuns' run-on and puts the new term at the end, where it stands out.
'So' at the start reads as 'in this way'; 'Daarom' makes the intended cause-and-effect link clear.
Causal 'oor' is colloquial and can be misread as 'about'; 'vanweë' states the reason plainly.

veranderings.voor: Dié kultuur sluit hul kennis in van hoe om in die woestyn te oorleef.
veranderings.na: Deel van dié kultuur is hul kennis van hoe om in die woestyn te oorleef.
veranderings.rede: The separable verb 'sluit ... in' splits the object awkwardly; the rewrite keeps the meaning and reads smoothly into 'Daarby hoort ...'.
The countable noun needs the article here to read naturally.

vlae.teks: Ons noem sulke prente op rotse rotskuns.
vlae.rede: The body sentence names rock art 'prente' (paintings of people and animals), while the decided definition deliberately says 'Kuns' and includes carving ('inkap'), because a later lesson calls some rock art patterns instead of pictures. Changing 'prente' would change content, so it is flagged rather than proposed; a person or the writer should decide whether the body sentence narrows the term.
